title: QUIC All-Upstream Handshake Matrix Verification
verification_method: Workflow-shape review, local helper dry-run tests, requirement-home tests, live local all-upstream handshake runner sweeps, and SpecTrace validation.
preconditions: Each registry entry used by the hosted matrix declares a role and image.
Handshake is the only testcase in the first all-upstream profile.
The helper local replacement slots remain `chrome` for local client mode and `nginx` for local server mode.
Client-role cells may receive runner-generated response bodies whose source files are mounted only into the peer server container.
scope: Verify that the repository can plan and host an advisory all-upstream handshake matrix across role-compatible peer slots without claiming broad testcase coverage or upstream registry participation.
procedure: Review `.github/workflows/interop-runner-handshake.yml` to confirm `all-implementation-matrix` is a workflow-dispatch-only profile and uses a preparation job to derive the matrix from the upstream registry.
Confirm the generated cells use local client mode for upstream `both` and `server` roles and local server mode for upstream `both` and `client` roles.
Confirm every generated hosted cell runs only the `handshake` testcase and uploads an artifact bundle with `if: always()`.
Run the helper dry-run tests to confirm `-PeerImplementationSlots all` expands role-compatible peers and rejects mixed explicit/all input.
Run the requirement-home copy test to confirm client-role downloads can read until peer FIN when the local source length is unavailable.
Run the `REQ-QUIC-INT-0027` requirement-home tests to confirm the canonical artifacts, workflow profile, helper, and documentation keep the advisory handshake-only boundary explicit.
Run local quic-interop-runner client-role and server-role all-upstream handshake sweeps against the current upstream implementation registry.
expected_result: The repository exposes a manual all-upstream handshake matrix that can run Incursa.Quic as client and server against every role-compatible upstream implementation slot while preserving advisory per-cell artifacts and avoiding every-testcase or support-readiness claims.
status_summary: Passed for the local repository surface and the May 19, 2026 local all-upstream handshake refresh. Focused helper and requirement-home tests prove the role-aware `all` expansion, workflow/profile trace links, and handshake-only advisory boundary. The local client-role sweep under `.artifacts/interop-runner/all-upstream-refresh-client-after-servername-ee/20260519-095835514-client-chrome` passed all 16 upstream server-capable handshake cells. The local server-role sweep under `.artifacts/interop-runner/all-upstream-refresh-server-after-admission/20260519-092739413-server-nginx` passed all 14 supported upstream client-capable handshake cells, with the upstream Chrome client row reported as unsupported rather than failed. Hosted all-upstream execution remains manual follow-up evidence and is not required for this workflow-surface verification.

supplemental_sections.heading: Advisory Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: Passing local plan tests or a future hosted handshake matrix does not prove every QUIC testcase, every peer feature, migration support, HTTP/3 support, or support readiness.
